rule: The migration-runner sqlx-cli version MUST equal the project's LOCKED sqlx version exactly. The validator re-reads core/Cargo.lock at check time and fails on any drift, staleness, or unjustified runner version.
justification: sqlx-cli and the sqlx runtime share the `_sqlx_migrations` metadata table layout and the migration checksum algorithm within a minor series. Pinning the CLI to the exact locked runtime version removes any format/checksum skew during `sqlx migrate run` and the subsequent drift verification. A network lookup is NOT the source of truth; core/Cargo.lock is.
